analysis: Examined LaunchAgent.swift (head 332-334 doc comment, 375 new allowlist entry SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpointsFlag) and the new test forwardsDeltaCheckpointRollbackToProviderJob (LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift head 336-360). The change only adds one operator-controlled env key to the launchd plist passthrough allowlist (passthroughEnvironment, head 418-439, unchanged: non-empty allowlisted values only, unrelated vars excluded). The operator already controls the environment and plist (TB-003, ADV-001), so persisting a rollback flag grants no new authority. The flag selects delta vs complete checkpoint files for the encrypted SSD prefix cache (T-041); the passthrough itself does not alter DBK3 crypto, HMAC lookup tags, TTL, disk budget, or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch. The test asserts the key is not in WatchdogAgent passthrough and that daemon/foreground parsing agree. Not visible here: SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpoints and the delta-checkpoint write path itself (default-on incremental checkpoints). If that delta format is new in this PR or elsewhere, integration should verify it keeps T-041 invariants (AAD over canonical metadata, no prompt-derived plaintext metadata beyond keyed lookupTag, base/delta dependency deletion under TTL/LRU/KEK purge, tamper fails closed with recompute). No regression identified in the supplied units.
